Anant sinh ki beti shivangi sinh ki hone vali shadi in dinon khub surkhiyan bator rahi hai. 25 navanbar ko shivangi ki shadi bihta nivasi rishikesh kumar urph ankit kumar se hone ja rahi hai. shadi ki taiyariyon ke bich log yahi saval puchh rahe hain ki aakhir shivangi ki hone vali sas hai kaun?
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
